messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to pick sequencing for Dedicated vs Private investments. Two big asks from enterprise sales: predictable reserved capacity (Dedicated) and VPC/on-prem for compliance (Private). Need product stance by EOD Wed.

Liam: Can you share the rough RICE numbers we discussed earlier? My read: Dedicated = faster revenue, Private = higher ACV but longer cycles.

Ana: From infra POV Dedicated is significantly lower lift — reuse current runtime + reserved pools. Private requires private control plane, KMS/HSM hooks, and installer workflows. Ballpark effort: Private ~3x Dedicated.

Zack: Sales input: two live deals are explicitly asking for Private (healthcare + finance). If we don't offer Private soon we risk losing both (~$500k ACV each, 12mo). Dedicated demand is broader but smaller per-customer.

Serena: Security note: Private triggers audit/logging/KMS and legal reviews. We should treat FedRAMP-ish checklist as a dependency for high-reg customers.

Noah: Research: customers value Private for compliance (7/10 urgency) but are OK waiting if we provide a clear timeline. Dedicated interest is immediate (9/10).

Maya: Proposed middle path: ship Dedicated GA fast (predictable capacity for mid-market) and run a narrow-scope "Private Core" MVP (VPC + private control plane, no on-prem installer initially). Draft RICE below — please flag if numbers look off.

Maya: ```
Feature          Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort(pts)  Score(R/I/C/E)
Dedicated (GA)    8k/mo   6        0.8         3           1280
Private Core      1k/mo   9        0.6         9           60
Full Private      500/mo  10       0.5         25          100

Notes: Reach = estimated customers/month; Impact on revenue/adoption; Effort relative points. Score formula simplified for discussion.
```

Liam: The Score math looks odd — Dedicated score huge because of low effort. That matches instincts but watch for long-term strategic value of Private. Also confidence on Private should probably be 0.65 given sales signals.

Ana: Implementation suggestion: design Private control plane as modular so routing, auth, and model pinning can be reused by Dedicated. That reduces duplicate work. Also freeze scope for Private MVP: VPC peering, customer-managed keys, audit logs stream. No on-prem or operator UI for first pass.

Zack: If we commit to this dual-track, sales needs a one-pager for customers explaining what "Private Core" includes and expected timelines. We can then salvage both deals if timeline acceptable.

Serena: I agree on scope freeze. Also request a mandatory security checkpoint before beta (S1 review). I'll add controls required for KMS/HSM and logging formats.

Noah: I'll draft customer comms and interview plan for early adopters. Suggest a small early access cohort (3 customers) to validate operational docs and onboarding flow.

Maya: Decision proposal: dual-track. Milestones: Dedicated GA in 6 weeks (autoscaling, reserved pools, billing hooks); Private Core MVP target 10 weeks (private control plane, VPC, KMS, audit logs). Launch criteria: internal e2e deploy, 1 pilot customer onboarded, runbook and SLOs defined, security signoff for Private.

Liam: Resource ask: we need to reserve 2 engs for Dedicated and 3 for Private Core for next 10 weeks. Otherwise they'll bleed into other work.

Ana: A note on capacity: Dedicated pooling will help autoscale headroom and reduce token unit cost; Private deploys will need dedicated capacity options per customer — plan capacity templates now.

Zack: I'll push timeline to the two buyers and see if they can accept "Private Core" + roadmap commit for full Private. If they accept, we can convert one to a pilot.

Serena: Security will block without KMS integration. Prioritize KMS API and HSM support in the sprint plan.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-2145 Dedicated GA planning epic. Ticket created: INF-2146 Private Core MVP epic.

Maya: Thanks — I'll write the PRD today with milestones, RICE appendix, and explicit launch criteria, then tag reviewers. If no major objections by noon tomorrow we'll lock resourcing.

Zack: +1 from sales.

Noah: I'll schedule customer interviews and draft the pilot onboarding checklist.

Liam: I'll sketch the sprint plan and resource matrix.

Ana: Will add infra tasks to INF-2145/2146 and estimate infra effort.

Serena: Adding security checklist to INF-2146.

Maya: Great. Moving to action items.
